verdict.rationale: Gmail is a SaaS email service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an official MCP server or endpoint. The REST API, push notifications and Workspace add-ons are developer building blocks rather than an MCP server, and they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
